Running command: python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"src/bn/relic_bn_util.c","function":"bn_read_bin","line":441,"var":"bin,len","code":"void bn_read_bin(bn_t a, const uint8_t *bin, int len)","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes and length enter the big-number parser from the input buffer."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src/bn/relic_bn_util.c","function":"bn_read_bin","line":444,"var":"digs","code":"int digs = (len % d == 0 ? len / d : len / d + 1);","note":"The input length is converted into a digit count that determines how much space the destination must hold."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/bn/relic_bn_util.c","function":"bn_read_bin","line":446,"var":"a","code":"bn_grow(a, digs);","note":"The destination big integer is resized to fit the computed digit count before copying bytes in."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/bn/relic_bn_util.c","function":"bn_read_bin","line":447,"var":"a->used","code":"a->used = digs;","note":"The number is marked as using all computed digits, even if the top digit later becomes zero."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/bn/relic_bn_util.c","function":"bn_read_bin","line":459,"var":"a->dp[i]","code":"a->dp[i] = d;","note":"The parsed bytes are copied into the digit array, producing a potentially zero high digit."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/bn/relic_bn_util.c","function":"bn_read_bin","line":463,"var":"a","code":"bn_trim(a);","note":"Normalization removes leading zero digits and can reduce used to 0 or 1 depending on the input."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/bn/relic_bn_mem.c","function":"bn_trim","line":133,"var":"a->used","code":"while (a->used > 0 && a->dp[a->used - 1] == 0) { --(a->used); }","note":"If the top digit is zero, trimming decrements used and may leave the object in a minimally sized state."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src/bn/relic_bn_add.c","function":"bn_add","line":111,"var":"a,b,c","code":"void bn_add(bn_t c, const bn_t a, const bn_t b)","note":"The parsed big integer later flows into arithmetic where addition dispatches to the internal add/sub helpers."},
  {"step":9,"file":"src/bn/relic_bn_add.c","function":"bn_add_imp","line":46,"var":"max,min,carry","code":"static void bn_add_imp(bn_t c, const bn_t a, const bn_t b)","note":"The helper computes the result size from the operand metadata and prepares to normalize the sum."},
  {"step":10,"file":"src/bn/relic_bn_add.c","function":"bn_add_imp","line":72,"var":"c","code":"bn_trim(c);","note":"The sum is trimmed after the low-level digit addition; the crash state reported by MSAN arises in this trim path when uninitialized high digits are observed."}
]
p.write_text(json.dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p)
